contracts.commit_point: deps/auth.py:133-135 — expected = hmac.new(secret.encode(), msg, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest(); if not hmac.compare_digest(expected, x_inhale_sig): raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail='sig mismatch') — together with the earlier pre-handler raises at deps/auth.py:75, 78, 83, 87, 89, 95, 97, 101; FastAPI dependency resolution completes before the route handler runs (e.g., routers/km_agent.py:657-659).
contracts.declared_mechanism: FastAPI dependency require_internal (deps/auth.py:57-142) exposed as InternalAuthDep = Annotated[dict, Depends(require_internal)] (deps/auth.py:143-145) and declared as a handler parameter on every route. It validates headers, signature version, timestamp freshness, and body size; builds the v2 canonical message via canonical_signature_message (deps/auth.py:31-54) over the signed path including the query string (deps/auth.py:105-118) or the legacy v1 message during rollout (deps/auth.py:16-28, 119-132); computes HMAC-SHA256 with INHALE_INTERNAL_SECRET; and compares via hmac.compare_digest, raising HTTPException before the handler body executes.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A request reaching any protected route handler that fails any pre-handler auth check: missing/oversized/control-character x-inhale-user-id (401, deps/auth.py:70-75), missing INHALE_INTERNAL_SECRET (503, deps/auth.py:76-78), unsupported signature version (401, deps/auth.py:79-83), non-integer or stale timestamp beyond 60 seconds (401, deps/auth.py:84-89), declared or actual body over 16 MiB (413; malformed content-length 400, deps/auth.py:91-101), or hmac.compare_digest mismatch between the computed signature and x-inhale-sig (401, deps/auth.py:133-135).

contracts.protected_operation: Serving the HMAC-protected internal agent routes POST /agents/km/invoke, POST /agents/km/resume, GET /agents/km/state/{thread_id}, GET /agents/km/threads-for-paper/{paper_id}, POST /agents/km/config, POST /agents/km/extract, GET /agents/km/debug/loaded_skills, GET /agents/km/skills/personal, and GET /agents/km/tools — each handler declares auth: InternalAuthDep.
contracts.protected_resource: The internal agents HTTP API surface of the KM deep-agent service (agent invocation, resume, state, threads-for-paper, config, extract, debug, diagnostics, and tool-inventory endpoints) and the agent runs/data reachable through them.
contracts.protection_obligation: Every internal /agents/* HTTP endpoint (as instantiated by the supplied router: POST /agents/km/invoke, POST /agents/km/resume, GET /agents/km/state/{thread_id}, GET /agents/km/threads-for-paper/{paper_id}, POST /agents/km/config, POST /agents/km/extract, GET /agents/km/debug/loaded_skills, GET /agents/km/skills/personal, GET /agents/km/tools) must reject, before its route handler executes, any request lacking a valid INHALE_INTERNAL_SECRET HMAC-SHA256 signature: the v2 canonical message binds timestamp, method, signed path (path plus query string), user_id, paper_id, and SHA-256 digests of secret-bearing headers and the body; timestamps older than FRESHNESS_SECONDS=60 are stale; bodies over MAX_INTERNAL_BODY_BYTES=16 MiB are rejected; legacy v1 signatures are accepted only during the GSD-215 rollout window.
scope_limits: Verified only against routes visible in the supplied services/agents/routers/km_agent.py view; whether additional /agents/* router modules exist is not determinable (repository enumeration is incomplete).

Legacy v1 signatures (absent or '1' version header) are accepted during the GSD-215 rollout and bind only ts + method + signed-path + body — no header digests (deps/auth.py:16-28, 119-132); the window's termination is undefined in supplied source.
The 16 MiB cap is enforced against the declared Content-Length header and the fully-read body length (deps/auth.py:91-101); no streaming/incremental cap is evidenced.
Missing INHALE_INTERNAL_SECRET yields 503 'internal auth unavailable' rather than 401 (deps/auth.py:76-78).
x-inhale-llm-key is deliberately excluded from the signed payload; replay is bounded only by the 60-second freshness window (deps/auth.py:61-64).
In-handler _reject_guest checks (e.g., routers/km_agent.py:659) are separate post-dependency validations and are not part of this contract's commit point.

The guard is web-framework request authentication; supplied source does not bind its commit point to any agent tool dispatch, in-agent lifecycle hook, or agent-generated input, so its DEC relevance depends on the unresolved mediation question recorded below.

contracts.commit_point: grounding_guard.py:85-96 — if not prior: return ToolMessage(..., status='error') at the awrap_tool_call wrap, so handler(request) is never invoked on this path (and csv_write_cell's downstream write at data.py:222-263 never starts); when a prior read exists, line 96 passes through to handler(request).
contracts.declared_mechanism: GroundingGuard(AgentMiddleware).awrap_tool_call (grounding_guard.py:44-96), registered on the compiled agent via middleware=[GroundingGuard()] passed to create_deep_agent in build_km_agent (km_agent.py:566); it filters request.tool.name == 'csv_write_cell', extracts grounding.paper_id from the tool-call args, searches the message history via _read_paper_targeted (grounding_guard.py:16-41) for a matching prior read_paper tool_call, and on absence returns an error ToolMessage without calling handler(request).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A model-issued csv_write_cell tool call with non-empty args.grounding.paper_id for which no AIMessage tool_call with name 'read_paper' and args.paper_id equal to that id exists in request.state['messages'] (grounding_guard.py:67-83) — i.e., writing a cell grounded in a paper the agent has not read earlier in this thread (rule stated at grounding_guard.py:44-56).
pending_binding_information: Whether subagents built via subagents.py (researcher/synthesizer/verifier) also carry GroundingGuard; their factories are not in supplied source.

Whether KM-side enforcement (referenced at tools/data.py:5-7) independently re-checks grounding/read preconditions for the direct cell-write path taken when configurable.allow_direct_csv_write is True (routers/km_agent.py:1465; data.py:252-253).
Whether any runtime guard covers cells with empty grounding.paper_id (source states the n/a rule is prompt-level only, grounding_guard.py:52-55).
contracts.protected_operation: Agent tool invocation of csv_write_cell (services/agents/tools/data.py:181-263, declared @tool with a grounding: Grounding parameter) dispatched through the deep agent's tool-call wrap.
contracts.protected_resource: Paperset/spreadsheet cell content in the user's KM drive that csv_write_cell would mutate via the KM papersets APIs; at the guard's stratum, the csv_write_cell tool invocation itself.
contracts.protection_obligation: Within the KM deep agent, a csv_write_cell tool call whose grounding.paper_id is set is forbidden unless the thread's message history already contains a read_paper tool call targeting that same paper_id; the registered GroundingGuard middleware must block such a call at the tool-call wrap, returning an error ToolMessage to the model instead of invoking the tool handler, so that no cell write grounded in an unread paper executes.
scope_limits: Applies only to csv_write_cell (grounding_guard.py:63-65); calls with empty/missing grounding.paper_id bypass the guard (grounding_guard.py:71-73), and the n/a-without-read rule is delegated to the inlined data-extract skill prompt, not this guard (grounding_guard.py:52-55).

History-scoped: the credited read_paper call must appear in the current agent state's messages (grounding_guard.py:75-83); reads from other threads are not credited. Empty/absent message state yields an empty prior set and blocks (fail-closed).

Registration is on the top-level create_deep_agent call in build_km_agent (km_agent.py:556-567), which the /invoke, /resume, and /extract paths all use (routers/km_agent.py:682-691, 929-938, 1412-1421); propagation to subagents is not evidenced.

The blocked tool's downstream effect is an HTTP write to the KM service (data.py:222-253, km_patch /api/papersets/{file_id}/cells or the enrich SSE route); the guard blocks at invocation and no KM-side enforcement is visible in supplied source.
The guard does not validate grounding block_ids or value semantics; cell-write.ts and server-side checks referenced at grounding_guard.py:53-55 are not supplied.
